summary: A program that imports a DLL from its directory: the DLL's entry runs once with DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH and a non-NULL lpReserved before the program's entry; the DLL sits at its preferred base; GetModuleHandleW finds it by any case and without its extension; the PEB's loader lists hold the program, ntdll, KERNEL32, KERNELBASE and the DLL, initialization order ntdll, KERNELBASE, KERNEL32, the DLL.
applicability: windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor)

initial.process: started by the runner's cmd with standard output redirected

acceptance.derivation: scripts/family_run.py loader_rows: apphelp.dll is in the loader lists of a binary's first execution on a runner and not of its second (16 runs, both images): the application-compatibility engine looks at a binary it has not seen. The rows drop it, with its count.

open_questions: apphelp.dll joins the lists on a binary's first execution on a runner; whether it does for the game started by Steam is not observed. The rows drop it.
The probe's DLL loaded at its preferred base on all 16 runs though it is ASLR-enabled; UnityPlayer.dll's base on Windows is not observed, and w2m places it at its preferred base when free.
ntdll's exports are not listed: GetProcAddress on ntdll stops the run.
